name: Stripe-based On-the-fly Decoding
definition: A general approach for applying sequential data compression schemes to blocks of data, decoded on-the-fly by the GPU in a single render pass by decomposing blocks into parallel stripes.
summary: Stripe-based On-the-fly Decoding is a GPU-accelerated method that decompresses volumetric data blocks directly during rendering by mapping sequential decoding onto fragment shaders processing parallel voxel stripes.
